simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to לַח (H3892) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: לַח (lach) means fresh , i.e. unused or undried First listed occurrence: Ezek 17 24.

definitions.full: H3892. lach לַח adjective moist, fresh, new ; — ׳ל Gen 30:37 ; Ezek 21:3 ; לָ֑ח 17:24 ; plural לַחִים Num 6:3 2 t.; — 1 moist, fresh , of trees, fruit, etc.; לַח לִבְנֶה Gen 30:37 (J); ל ׳עֵץ Ezek 17:24 ; 21:3 ; grapes ל ׳עֲנָבִים Num 6:3 . 2 new , of cords, ל ׳יְתָרִים Judg 16:7-8 , probably made of fresh sinews of animal (compare Syriac PS 1652 ; GFM on the passage )
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to be new;
